**Daily Devotional**

**June 22**

*11 And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie: (2 Thessalonians 2:11 KJV)*

The Lord will not ever cause a person to have a strong delusion to keep them from being saved, as He is not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance (2 Peter 3:9). The Lord will someday cause this delusion to happen in those who reject the truth that He has shown them, and this is what will cause the great falling away from the church in the last days (2 Thessalonians 2:3). Everyone needs to be saved and make Jesus his or her Lord before God sends forth this delusion. God will only do this to those who willfully reject Jesus and He will only be enforcing the rejection that they have already chosen.

This is all the more reason we need to seek God while He is available, as someday it will be too late to do so (Isaiah. 55:6). This will cause the gray area to be done away with, and everyone will be either hot or cold concerning God and Jesus (Revelation 3:16). It is not wise at all to postpone being saved and accepting Jesus as your Lord. Because when the falling away begins, God will not be calling on us to be saved any longer, and the Word tells us that we can only be saved when God calls us to be saved (John 6:44). Thank you Lord for your Mercy, Grace and Love to us your children.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
